## Monthly and one-time charges
- **Recurring monthly:** Data Processing, $18.00 for 40 DBU.
- **One-time:** none. No migration or one-time model job was included.
- **No other engines are priced.** SQL, DataSync, S3/KMS, model endpoints and one-time model jobs are all marked not applicable, so they are not estimated. They are not zero-cost placeholders. \[[2](https://fevm-classic-stable-naren.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1d6efcecd1620b04cf487817675b7/chats/01f1d6f047e61d7889278ace08e1d444?o=7474644082064164&gra_focus=pub_toolu_bdrk_01MpJwqpHGPmM6dgTsHMMQGj)\]

## Method and pricing basis
- **Compute choice:** the calculator selected serverless jobs compute for B1. The alternative it considered was a serverless pipeline, and its confidence in the choice is medium.
- **Formula:** 20 runs per month × 2 hours per run × 1 DBU per hour = 40 DBU. At $0.45 per DBU that is $18.00.
- **Rate:** $0.45 per DBU, marked reference-only, from the system list prices. The calculator warns that list prices are used for testing, and that production estimates should use account prices. A governed account rate would likely change the figure.

## Assumptions
- **DBU intensity:** 1 DBU per hour is the calculator's planning default, not a measured value. This drives the LOW confidence rating, since 100% of the cost rests on planning assumptions.
- **Confirmed inputs:** you supplied the 2-hour runtime and the 20 runs per month.
- **Scenario:** only EXPECTED was run, so there is no low-to-high range.

This is an internal planning estimate, not an invoice or committed run rate. All of the engines you excluded stay excluded, so I won't suggest them again.
